name: nawras-arcade
description: Bilingual RTL-first arcade engine: one codebase, PHP 8.3 dynamic + static export, license ledger, bucketed leaderboard (8 CloudArcade-compatible period types) and schema migrations.

scripts.test: npm run -s bridge && python3 tools/verify_php.py && python3 tools/prove_runtime.py && python3 tools/prove_audit.py && python3 scripts/build_oss_pack.py --verify && python3 tools/prove_provider.py && python3 tools/check_audit_parity.py && python3 tools/audit_ledger.py data/ledger.example.json && python3 tools/gen_schema_sql.py --verify && python3 -c "import json;[json.load(open(f)) for f in ['db/schema.json','db/migrations.json','data/ledger.example.json']];print('\u2713 json valid')"
